goal: lifecycle.py gains an Outcome.RECOVERED member that round-trips through both store backends and is excluded from the failure-outcome set.

references: src/flywheel/lifecycle.py:20 -- Outcome enum, add RECOVERED = "recovered" alongside the existing members
src/flywheel/event_serde.py:162 and src/flywheel/store_sqlite.py:1052 and src/flywheel/store_postgres.py:1527 -- Outcome(value) deserialization; the new string must round-trip
constraints: tests/test_lifecycle.py:34 (test_outcome_enumerates_exactly_the_five_spec_outcomes) pins the exact Outcome member set -- update its expected set AND its name to include 'recovered' in this same commit, or the suite goes red.
Do NOT add Outcome.RECOVERED to _FAILED_OUTCOMES (lifecycle.py:70): per spec it is neither success nor failure, so it must not count as a failed outcome.
lifecycle.py must stay pure (no json/pathlib/io/open) -- enforced by tests/test_lifecycle_module_purity.py.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not add any harness trigger logic, config field, or store column -- this task only introduces the enum member and keeps every exhaustive Outcome consumer green.
Do not add a new Status member or transition edge -- RECOVERED is recorded via the existing retry arm (READY/RUNNING).
edge_cases: Outcome.RECOVERED must deserialize from the persisted 'recovered' string via event_serde and both SqliteStore and PostgresStore attempt loaders.

graders.run: uv run pytest tests/test_lifecycle.py tests/test_lifecycle_module_purity.py tests/test_store_contract.py tests/test_events.py
graders.name: tests

graders.run: uv run python -c "from flywheel.lifecycle import Outcome, _FAILED_OUTCOMES; assert Outcome.RECOVERED.value == 'recovered'; assert Outcome.RECOVERED not in _FAILED_OUTCOMES"
